title: Description and error analysis of quantum alghorithms in the projection evolution model -- the Deutsch algorithm case
summary: This work demonstrates that the Deutsch algorithm can be effectively modelled using a two-level harmonic oscillator within the second quantization formalism. By adopting this framework, evolution operators are derived. We present a projection evolution model that accurately characterizes the physical state transformation within quantum gates. This approach provides a systematic method for finding evolution operators, enabling the complete description and prediction of state evolution - including projection errors - in quantum algorithms.
